reviews.text:

reviews.author: Suthakar
reviews.text: Accumed Speciality Clinic is an excellent choice for anyone seeking fertility and gynecology-related treatments. Dr. Aishwarya and Dr. Ashwin are truly exceptional in their fields. Dr. Aishwarya provides compassionate and expert care, guiding patients through every step of their journey. Dr. Ashwin, with his extensive experience in radiology, ensures that every scan is thoroughly explained, making patients feel informed and reassured. The clinic’s friendly staff and welcoming atmosphere further enhance the experience, making it a place where you feel genuinely cared for.

reviews.author: Siva Sankari
reviews.text:
Our 4 years of Marriage and struggling with fertility issues, and previously we have done 2 IUI AND 1 IVF treatment in previous hospitals. But it was failure. Our journey took a positive turn when we discover Dr.Aishwarya Mam at ASCS.

When we Meet Dr.Aishwarya Mam in our First initial Consultation, her smiling and very caring, showed genuine empathy and attentiveness. She took the time to listen to our concerns, understand our medical history and patiently explained our treatment options. Her reassuring and compassionate approach immediately put us at ease, making us feel confident on her.
Throughout the entire process, Dr.Aishwarya Mam remained accessible and approachable. She answered all our questions and provide clear explanations, and supported us emotionally, making the entire journey less daunting. Her expertise and dedication shone through, assuring us that we were in the best hand possible.

In this treatment, We did double stimulation, each stimulation we got grade C embryo only. She told we try with these embryo. We blindly trust with GOD and Dr. Aishwarya. She transfer the embryo. With god blessings I am pregnant and deliver a Baby Boy. We are very happy.
Thanks to Dr.Aishwarya and Dr.Ashwin at Accumed Speciality clinic and Scans.
Clinic is very good locality, premises is well maintained. Staff are good caring.

May god bless you forever and keep you bring joy and happiness to many couples.💐💐🤱🏻👨🏼‍🍼👨‍👩‍👧

She is a very friendly person apart from being an awesome gynaecologist..
I recommend her to each and every couple who are planning for a baby..
